description: Facilitates the Constitution movement of a Tutti design session. Use at the start of an app-level design chain to draw out the project's principles and non-negotiables (the things that must stay true no matter what), which ride in every later movement's context. Asks one question at a time and emits the movement's artifact section when both principles and non-negotiables are covered.
